Class SvgOptions

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.export.svg.SvgOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExportOptions
public final class SvgOptions extends Object implements ExportOptions
Options for SVG export. All values have reasonable defaults. Used by the fluent export API; see Formats.SVG.

  • Method Details

    • chrome

      public SvgOptions chrome(boolean chrome)
      Sets whether to include window chrome (frame, title, traffic-light buttons). When false, the SVG contains only the terminal content with minimal padding.
      Parameters:
      chrome - true to include chrome (default), false for content only
      Returns:
      this options instance

    • title

      public SvgOptions title(String title)
      Sets the window title.
      Parameters:
      title - the SVG window title
      Returns:
      this options instance

    • styles

      public SvgOptions styles(StylePropertyResolver styles)
      Sets the style property resolver for default export foreground/background. When null (default), export uses ExportProperties defaults (dark-theme). When set (e.g. from the toolkit style engine), the resolver supplies values for export-foreground and export-background.
      Parameters:
      styles - the style resolver, or null to use property defaults
      Returns:
      this options instance

    • fontAspectRatio

      public SvgOptions fontAspectRatio(double fontAspectRatio)

      Returns:
      this options instance

    • uniqueId
